reply: Thank you, Nora. Wishing you and Ben a lovely first visit to Prague—and a happy anniversary, with plenty of scenic-route moments.

closing.reason: Nora said there was nothing else after the final invitation for additions or corrections.

threads.topic: Eight-year anniversary and first visit to Prague
threads.detail: They are celebrating eight years together and visiting Prague for the first time.
Nothing is booked; they want one nice dinner and slow, unhurried wandering with café and bookshop stops. They prefer breakfast after nine and no early tours, schedules or group tours.
Nora loves architecture and old staircases.
Ben likes jazz and little bookshops.
They both like fish, roast vegetables and lemon desserts. Nora usually drinks sparkling water; Ben sometimes has red wine. They prefer dinner that is not too drawn-out or formal.
Neither has allergies or dietary restrictions.
Nora loves dried apricots and Ben loves dark chocolate; they like separate stashes.
They share a bed but prefer two duvets. Nora is usually warm and prefers a firm pillow; Ben is usually cold and prefers a soft pillow. Ben reads before breakfast.
Nora does ten minutes of yoga and likes a morning cappuccino; Ben likes Earl Grey without milk and reads before breakfast. They like breakfast after nine and do not want early tours.

They welcome a small, private nod to meeting while sheltering from rain outside a bookshop and their phrase “still taking the scenic route together.” They do not want public announcements or staged romance.
Nora requests no added room fragrance, likes irises and dislikes a strong floral smell. Ben has no favourite flower.
They enjoy warm, informal chats and people's own recommendations, prefer wandering independently and do not want constant check-ins.
